coverage: Namespace signature checked against independently supplied signer and expected scope.
Exact ordered correspondence between verified discovery and namespace index.
Missing, duplicated, reordered and seal-mismatched index entries reject; a correctly signed duplicate index also rejects.
Every object archive authenticates all packets and completion against shared resource evidence and matches its indexed inventory/seal digest.
Damaged/symlinked namespace completion and missing object packets reject.
Shared bounded, non-following file readers preserve existing archive and discovery validation/recovery contracts.
limits: Verifier performs no target RPC or R2 operations; current R2 contents require independent readback verification.
Discovery source is a local fixture, not proof of production enumeration completeness.
Global isolation, durable target mapping and namespace restore/release remain open.
No deployed account qualification or remote publication.
